messages:
sam: heads-up — argocd started looping on the app-of-apps in eu-west around 09:04 UTC. lots of HelmRelease reconcile failures and a bunch of GPU-pool apps stuck in prune state. seen any alerts?

maya: saw that, getting 429s from the git server during prune waves then a cascade of helm hook jobs failing. also some pods Pending in gpu-pool with nodeSelector mismatch.

raj: stacktrace from controller looks like Authorization error when creating serviceaccount tokens across account-bound clusters. suspect the cross-account serviceAccount annotation we added for node bootstrapping isn't propagating.

ben: quick snippet from argocd logs: `error="rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc=unable to create token for serviceaccount: annotations mismatch"` — and then argo schedules a prune for the same objects repeatedly.

sam: hmm. it only started after we upgraded terraform modules last night (k8s nodepool module v2.1 -> v3.0). module removed the `iam:serviceAccount` tag we relied on. terraform plan looked clean because outputs changed shape.

maya: that explains the autoscaler side too — nodes coming up without the `gpu:enabled` label so the GPU pods stay Pending. cluster-autoscaler refuses to scale the GPU pool because nodegroup label filter doesn't match.

infra-bot: Deploy bot: argocd/eu-west/app-of-apps sync status: Degraded -> Attempted sync 28 times in last 15m. Prune: 14 resources pending deletion.

raj: immediate mitigation: patch the affected clusters' serviceaccount annotations to add the old annotation back, and annotate helmrelease with `argocd.argoproj.io/sync-options: SkipHooks=false`? actually skip hooks would skip cleanup jobs — we probably want to let hooks finish. For now I'll patch the SA so token creation works.

ben: also recommend temporarily increasing argocd controller backoff / disable automated pruning for app-of-apps to stop the cascade while we fix infra. run:
```
kubectl -n argocd patch cm argocd-cm --type merge -p '{"data":{"controller.backoff":"5s"}}'
```

maya: rolling that patch now. running a small script to add `gpu:enabled=true` to the new nodepools so pending pods can schedule while we revert tf change.

sam: thanks. after SA patch + node labels we should run a one-off reconcile and then monitor for any remaining orphaned finalizers. if helm hook jobs already leaked finalizers we'll need to manually delete them with `kubectl patch` to unblock prune.

raj: noted — I'll also open a short PR to the terraform module to preserve the serviceAccount tag and add a guard in the CI plan check to warn on removed named outputs.

ben: after quick patch everything started to unwind: argo retries dropped, pending pods started scheduling, and prune queue shrank. leaving the thread for postmortem notes. :thumbsup:

sam: filing a postmortem ticket with timeline and the terraform diff. we should add a test that runs a dry-run of argocd prune on a staging app-of-apps whenever nodepool or iam outputs change.

infra-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0482 linked to this thread.

maya: thanks team, will follow up with the exact commands in the incident ticket.
